description: Text to speech through provider::<id>::speak: {model?, provider?, text, voice?, format?} to {provider, model, audio_base64, mime}. Resolves the provider from the catalog's tts models when none is named.

format.description: Audio container wanted: `mp3` (default), `wav`, `pcm16`, `opus`. Providers answer with what they can and say so in `mime`.

language.description: BCP-47 language hint for multilingual voices.

model.description: Text-to-speech model id (a `tts` model from `router::models::list`); the provider's default when omitted.

provider.description: Provider id; resolved from the model's catalog owner when omitted.

speed.description: Speaking-rate multiplier; 1.0 is the voice's own pace.

voice.description: Voice id or name as the provider knows it; the provider's default when omitted.

mime.description: MIME type of the audio, e.g. `audio/mpeg`.
